input.question: What is the population of Kensett?

documents.text: ] As of the census [ 5 ] of 2000 , there were 1,791 people , 699 households , and 445 families residing in the city . The population density was 1,008.4 inhabitants per square mile ( 389.3/km 2 ) . There were 778 housing units at an average density of 438.0 per square mile ( 169.1/km 2 ) .
